title: "Running Tests"

# Running Tests

Tests are organized into 7 separate executables to avoid ODR/CUDA linking issues.

## Running All Tests

```bash
ctest --preset serial
ctest --preset openmp
ctest --preset cuda-gcc12
```

## Running Specific Test Executables

```bash
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_core          # Builders, basic data structures, VTK
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_ops           # Set algebra (union, intersection, difference)
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_advanced      # Field ops, morphology, threshold
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_amr           # Refine/project, remap, multilevel
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_fvd_api       # FVD compilation tests
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_fvd_execution # FVD numerical validation
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_fvd_integrators # Time integrators, AMR
```

## Experimental Tests

When using experimental presets:

```bash
ctest --preset experimental-serial
ctest --preset experimental-openmp
ctest --preset experimental-cuda-gcc12
```

## Test Organization

| Test Suite | Contents |
|------------|----------|
| `subsetix_test_core` | Core data structures, builders, VTK I/O |
| `subsetix_test_ops` | Set algebra operations |
| `subsetix_test_advanced` | Advanced operations (morphology, threshold) |
| `subsetix_test_amr` | AMR refine/project, multilevel operations |
| `subsetix_test_fvd_api` | FVD layer compilation |
| `subsetix_test_fvd_execution` | FVD numerical correctness |
| `subsetix_test_fvd_integrators` | Time integrators |
